cards.text: The Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread are two days away, and everybody's getting ready for a feast. But the chief priests and scribes, Israel's religious leaders, are getting ready for something ELSE, friend. They're looking for a covert way to go after Jesus.

cards.question: Two days before the Passover, what are the chief priests and scribes looking for a covert way to do?

answers.text: Question Jesus in front of a crowd

cards.text: They've got one condition. "But not during the feast," they say.

cards.question: The chief priests and scribes say they won't arrest Jesus during the feast, or there may be a ___ among the people.

cards.text: Now Jesus is in the village of Bethany, reclining at the table in the home of Simon the Leper (not Simon Peter). Reclining, friend, and if I tried that on this gold base, I'd roll across the bakery like a runaway rolling pin.
Then a woman comes in with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, made of pure nard. This is NOT the bottle you pull out on some random Tuesday.

cards.question: In Simon the Leper's home, what does the woman do with her alabaster jar of perfume?

answers.text: Breaks it open and pours it on Jesus' head
Hands it to Simon as a gift for the house
Sets it down unopened at Jesus' feet

cards.text: Not everybody is a fan, and just like that, this dinner has a finance committee. Some of those present get indignant and say to one another, "Why this waste of perfume?"

cards.question: The people grumbling about the woman say her perfume could have been sold. For how much?
The grumblers say the money from the perfume could have been given to the ___, and they scold the woman.

cards.text: Then Jesus steps in, friend. "Leave her alone; why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful deed to Me."

cards.question: Jesus tells the grumblers that they will always have Him with them.
Jesus says the woman has done what she could. What does He say her perfume did?

answers.text: Anointed His body in advance of His burial
Marked Him as the king who was coming
Made Him ready for the Passover meal

cards.question: Jesus says that wherever the gospel is preached in all the world, what this woman did will be told in memory of her.

cards.text: Remember the chief priests looking for a covert way to arrest Jesus? Well, friend... one of the Twelve, Jesus' chosen disciples, goes straight to them to betray Him.

cards.question: Which one of the Twelve goes to the chief priests to betray Jesus?
The chief priests are ___ to hear what Judas Iscariot has come to do, and they promise to give him ___.

cards.text: So Judas begins to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus. The feast is coming, friend, and this story is far from over.
